primary_metric: Common clipped BCE natural logs,clip[1e-7,1-1e-7]; lowerbetter; bounded comparison metric, not strictlyproper onraw[0,1].

seed_uncertainty.limits: Each of four populations separately; five training seeds conditional on one split/router/recipe/selection. No pooling20 seed/population cells as independent tasks; t interval assumptions and small n apply.

record_bootstrap.quantiles: NumPy linear quantiles; primary alpha=.05/16 with separate adjusted percentiles; descriptive2.5/97.5. Approximate bootstrap tails.

probability_quality.reliability: 10 fixed equal-width bins with float64 edges np.linspace(0,1,11); [edge_i,edge_i+1) except final includes 1. Empty bins count 0 and means null, omit weighted ECE contribution. Per-seed bin counts, mean probability and mean label.
probability_quality.native_loss: All six arms use unbounded stable-logit BCE. Record native logits/loss and common clipped BCE, including probability bounds and wrong extreme predictions. No legacy raw-probability arm in v0.6.

numerical.native_policy: Independent native logits and stable native loss must meet these absolute limits in addition to unchanged probability, canonical metric and class-band gates. No tolerance relaxation after outcomes.

milestones.interpretation: All thresholds descriptive, never stopping/pass gates. Annulus has10 percent independent label noise:97 percent against observed labels is not a sensible expected generalization target. Reached-only medians and censored counts must be shown.

gate: All120 full B endpoints, independent all-round validation audit and root hash-bound release before any test outcomes.

label_semantics.primary: Observed labels only. No clean labels/flip masks in training, routing, selection or prediction.
label_semantics.supplemental: After root release, annulus latent-clean metrics and known conditional-probability/Bayes-reference metrics are labeled descriptive oracle diagnostics, not fair deployable model arms.

imbalance.metrics: Observed prevalence and confusion matrix, positive precision and recall, and tie-aware noninterpolated average precision per seed; descriptive mean/sampleSD. No fitted threshold or reweighting.
imbalance.average_precision: Group identical scores, descending order. Sum each group positive-count divided by total positives times cumulative precision at group end. Return null if no positives. No trapezoidal PR-AUC claim.
